segments.name: Offshore Drilling
segments.description: Ownership and operation of drillships and semi-submersible rigs for offshore drilling services to oil and gas companies.
segments.evidence: Our primary business is the ownership and operation of drillships and semi-submersible rigs for operations in shallow to ultra-deepwater in both benign and harsh environments.

revenueModel.text: Oil and gas companies contract drilling units at agreed dayrates for fixed contract terms, with customers bearing ancillary well construction and drilling support costs.
revenueModel.evidence: We contract our drilling units to oil and gas companies to provide offshore drilling services at an agreed dayrate for a fixed contract term or on a well completion basis.

changes.text: In 2024, the company disposed of four jackup rigs (West Castor, West Telesto, West Tucana, West Prospero) and divested a fifty percent equity interest in the Gulfdrill joint venture.
changes.evidence: The gain on disposals of $ 234 million for the year ended December 31, 2024 relates to the disposal of the West Castor , West Telesto and West Tucana jackup rigs, along with our 50 % equity interest in the Gulfdrill joint venture during the second quarter of 2024, and the disposal of the West Prospero during the fourth quarter of 2024.
